🚨 Traffic Advisory – IPL 2026 🏏

In view of IPL 2026 matches at RGIC Stadium, Uppal, traffic congestion is expected on select dates in April & May.

📅 Match Dates: Apr 5, 13, 18, 21 & May 3, 6, 22
📍 Location: Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium, Uppal
🚛 Traffic Diversions:
Heavy vehicles like Lorries, Trucks, Tippers, Water Tankers, JCBs, Private Buses & Tractors will be diverted within Uppal Traffic PS limits.

#TrafficAdvisory  #IPL2026 #StayAlert #PublicSafety #MalkajgiriPolice
